no new code. max=54: RFC-527 (RFC-294 S12 step 8) dropped the fallback-only parameters of the source-control selections (the repository Git selection's legacy runner typeof, the exclude-profile selection's app-home reader) and the exclude-profile selection itself (56 -> 54, measured). max=56: RFC-479 (RFC-294 S11) — public type deviations (the architecture report section publicSurfaceDeviations; the no-op reselectRunInTx is gone); RFC-485 measures 68 -> 65 (the node-run, node-output and task-gate query factories reach collaboration through the bindings and memory through its assembly input); RFC-483 measures 65 -> 57 (the three SQL conditions left the public; collaboration's badge read model takes them through the bindings); RFC-492 withdraws modelKey with the fourteen family-only runtime-management public members (57 -> 56: its unsafe/open type entry); no growth authorized.
